title: The Company at Sadovaya Street
subtitle: A story of run {run}, told from the Panel's own words
chapter_one_text: It was a late evening in the city when the paper was slipped under the door of the apartment on Sadovaya Street. Adversary's company gathered around the round table, and Gauge Breaker moved the lamp so that everyone could read it.
no_task: The paper was blank. Nobody in the company could say afterwards what exactly they had been asked to do, and Defect Hunter made a note to ask next time.
chapter_two_text: No one in the company believed the task would be easy, and no one said so aloud. One after another, they gave their view.
no_voices: Nobody's words were recorded. The company sat in silence until the lamp went out, and this story will not invent what they might have said.
absent_roles: {count} members of the company did not speak at all: {names}. The story leaves their chairs empty rather than inventing words for them.
chapter_three: What they left on the table
outcome_status: When the clock in the hall struck midnight, the work stood as {status}.
outcome_verdict: Adversary read the evidence and named it {verdict}.
outcome_unknown: When the clock in the hall struck midnight, nobody had written down how the work stood.
outcome_close: Then the company put on their coats, and the apartment was quiet again. Whatever they had found stayed on the table for whoever came next.
reflection: Which of these voices did you believe before you checked what it said?
Where did one character catch another's mistake, and would you have caught it yourself?
If you had been at the table, which claim of your own would you have wanted someone to test?
reflection_blocked: Some turns were blocked. Would you have noticed if this story had smoothed them over?
